title: Replay snapshot manifest
description: Written by scripts/music-pipeline/snapshots/store.mjs after a completed acquisition run. Never contains URLs with query strings, request headers, tokens, cookies, or browser-profile data. Absent entries record that a resource does not exist: they are pathless and carry no payloadSha256. Only present entries have a raw/ path and a payload hash. years are unique four-digit strings, and snapshot kind/id pairs are unique across entries; the (kind, id) cross-entry uniqueness is enforced by the Python validator (scripts/music-pipeline/canonicalize/validate.py, the authoritative implementation) because JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness of a projected key. runId and id must contain a non-whitespace character (mirrored by the Python validator's trimmed-nonempty check). fetchedAt and observedAt are RFC 3339 date-times: the pattern pins the ABNF's mandatory T separator and colon-separated numeric offset, which the Python validator also requires.

fetchedAt.$comment: The format keyword (as implemented by ajv-formats' full mode) also accepts the RFC 3339 NOTE's space separator and colonless numeric offsets, while the authoritative Python validator rejects both, so the pattern pins the stricter RFC 3339 ABNF: mandatory T separator and colon-separated numeric offset.
